claims: UCLA Bruins defeated Texas Longhorns 51-44 in 2026 NCAA Women's Final Four matchup
UCLA Bruins advanced to their first-ever national championship game
Lauren Betts led UCLA Bruins with a double-double
UCLA held Texas to under 10 points in first quarter
Game venue was Mortgage Matchup Center, Phoenix, AZ
Lauren Betts of UCLA had 16 points and 11 rebounds
Madison Booker of Texas made 3-of-23 field goals
Texas had previously beaten UCLA earlier in the season
UCLA advances to face South Carolina in national championship game on Sunday
Lauren Betts blocked Madison Booker layup attempt in final minute
Kiki Rice secured win with free throws in final seconds
